EGR GAS TEMPERATURE SENSOR COMPONENTS FOR REMOVAL AND INSTALLATION

EGR Gas Temperature Sensor

P12045
212598

EGR GAS TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSPECTION

1. REMOVE EGR GAS TEMPERATURE SENSOR
2. INSPECT EGR GAS TEMPERATURE SENSOR
Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between the terminals.
Resistance:
At 50˚C (112˚F)
64–97 kΩ
At 100˚C (212˚F)
11–16 kΩ
At 150˚C (302˚F)
2–4 kΩ
If the resistance is not as specified, replace the sensor.
Torque: 20 N·m (200 kgf·cm, 14 ft·lbf)
3. REINSTALL EGR GAS TEMPERATURE SENSOR

Ohmmeter
